incident-bot: [P0] geo-dns resolver spike: unusual REFUSED/timeout responses observed when resolving eu endpoints. Trigger threshold exceeded for eu-west POPs. Pager: PD10192. Initial detection 2026-03-15T02:34:27Z

raj: I'll take on-call. Quick triage: FRA/AMS edges showing high refusal counts. Apps seeing a correlated uptick in 5xx/timeouts. Running dig and checking our edge resolver traces now.

sophia: netops here. CF status page shows no global outage but we have an open ticket CF-765432. Their telemetry indicates a subset of FRA resolvers returning REFUSED, likely an internal mitigation rule.

raj: reproducible from our eu test host:
``
$ dig @1.1.1.1 api.redwood.ai
;; connection timed out; no servers could be reached
;; got REFUSED from 172.65.32.9
```
GeoDNS healthchecks are marking Cloudflare endpoints unhealthy -> some traffic is failing over incorrectly.

marco: prod-sre here. Short-term: force GeoDNS to prefer route53-eu for eu-west prefix, set TTL=30s, and disable automatic failover for ~10m. That should stop routing oscillation. I'll submit the change.

raj: +1. Also add fallback: if Cloudflare returns REFUSED, route to route53-eu immediately. Avoid complete blackholes.

deploy-bot: change-request CR-9982 created by marco -> set eu-west primary to route53-eu, ttl=30s. Approver: raj.

marco: applying change now.

marco: updated DNS policy (change id dns-change-177300). Rolling out to geo nodes. TTL=30s.

deploy-bot: rollout started for dns-change-177300 -> target: eu geo nodes.

alice: cs: getting ~40 tickets from EU customers reporting timeouts and 503s. Sending proactive note to impacted accounts.

raj: monitoring: upstream DNS refusal rate dropping from ~600/min to ~50/min over 4m. API 5xxs decreasing. Cache TTLs mean some customers will still see errors for up to 30s.

cloudflare-support: (CF) We've located anomalous refusal responses from a FRA resolver cluster caused by an aggressive DDoS mitigation rule. We're tuning thresholds; ETA unknown but investigating. Ticket CF-765432 updated.

sophia: thanks. Action: keep TTL low and route through Route53 until CF confirms stable. We'll plan to switch back once CF confirms.

raj: handoff note for next oncall -> @lina you take at 03:20Z. Current status: manual Route53 failover in place, errors trending down. Open tasks: confirm CF fix, validate resolver health from three eu hosts, prepare rollback canary.

lina: ack. I'll monitor CF ticket and the support queue.

marco: runbook for rollback:
``
- verify dig from three eu hosts against cf resolvers: should return A/AAAA (no REFUSED)
- require 3 consecutive successful checks spaced 60s apart
- Console -> DNS routing -> set primary back to cloudflare-eu
- set TTL to 60s; monitor for 10m
- if REFUSED spikes >50/min -> rollback to route53-eu
```

raj: opening incident record and dashboards. RCA after stabilization. Owners: netops (sophia), prod-sre (marco), eng-runtime (raj).

alice: I'll hold off external advisory until Lina confirms stability.

incident-bot: PD10192 acknowledged by raj. Severity P0. Status: mitigated (manual Route53 failover). Next update scheduled 2026-03-15T02:55:00Z.

lina: quick update: CF reports mitigations applied at 02:48Z. My dig checks from FRA/AMS/PRG show successful answers now. Waiting 3m then will run canary.

marco: execute canary and ping me the result. Watching dashboards.

lina: canary: flipping 10% of nodes back to cloudflare-eu. Observing for 3m...

lina: canary looks clean. No REFUSED or increased 5xx in the canary slice.

marco: roll full flip to cloudflare-eu TTL=60s.

deploy-bot: dns-change-177317 initiated -> primary=cloudflare-eu, ttl=60s.

marco: rollout complete. All EU geo nodes show primary cloudflare-eu.

raj: monitoring: DNS error rate at baseline, API 5xx normal. Closing mitigation window. Incident remains open for RCA and CF follow-up.

cloudflare-support: (CF) Resolution: adjusted edge mitigation thresholds; FRA resolver cluster cleared. Continuing monitoring. CF ticket CF-765432 updated with post-action notes.

lina: handoff closed. I'll draft a short incident summary for CS and schedule RCA sync with CF + netops.

alice: sending customer status update now and posting brief note to #general.

incident-bot: PD10192 status -> mitigated -> monitoring. Incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/PD10192
